ينفضح (form VII)
# يَنْفَضِحُ (yanfaḍiḥu) /jan.fa.dˤi.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# يَنْفَضِحَ (yanfaḍiḥa) /jan.fa.dˤi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# يَنْفَضِحْ (yanfaḍiḥ) /jan.fa.dˤiħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
